cursor_cloud_task_catalog.claim: Cursor Cloud Agent Task catalogs stayed built-in-only for Kaola custom types. A consumer with 14 git-tracked project profiles still exposed generalPurpose, explore, cursor-guide, bugbot, security-review, and best-of-n-runner; omit-model and inherit generalPurpose succeeded; cursor-grok-4.6-high was resolver-rejected. A later producer Cloud parent also lacked Kaola names and additionally exposed explore, computerUse, and videoReview.

cursor_cli_named_profile_20260827.claim: Authenticated standalone Cursor CLI build 2026.08.25-3e8eec8 discovered an explicit project materialization and dispatched the exact custom implementer type. The parent omitted a model override; the Task carrier resolved cursor-grok-4.6-medium and the child returned the requested read-only probe token.

cursor_app_local_named_profile_20260827.claim: Cursor App 3.17.21 local IDE Agent exposed all 14 project Kaola types and successfully dispatched exact implementer without repository mutation. The UI did not expose the selected child model, effort, or profile-source carrier.

cursor_cloud_preboot_catalog_20260827.claim: Negative control: a brand-new App-started Cloud chat selected branch probe/cursor-cloud-1041-20260827a at commit ead40c2741f4cae7e0a0cb473bba8a8a4a80c7a6, where all 14 project Cursor profiles were committed before the Agent launch but were not installed by the Cloud environment Build. Its live Task enum remained built-in-only: generalPurpose, explore, computerUse, videoReview, cursor-guide, bugbot, security-review, and best-of-n-runner; exact implementer was absent and no substitute was dispatched. A checked-in catalog alone is not equivalent to installing the selected Cloud environment before snapshot.

cursor_cloud_saved_environment_20260827.claim: Historical positive control: Cursor dashboard Build bld-20260827-aaac14bf-e980-4d1a-9600-e8b3fb2e031e exposed all 14 Kaola names and exact implementer, but its released-10.0.1 global installer also wrote an ambient project catalog. Clean Build bld-20260827-1fd163c3-a8f2-475d-9603-7da988673ee3 later falsified user-global discovery alone: the live Task enum stayed built-in-only despite 14 current user files. These controls require the final environment-setup Build to install both its remote machine authority and its selected repository before snapshot.

cursor_cloud_environment_setup_20260828.claim: Cursor Cloud environment setup confirmed candidate 101250f293a5439ed73e8ee2127c7501fba9e883, installed the remote machine authority and explicitly materialized the selected repository, and passed current receipt, authority-binding, 14-agent, collision, and byte-idempotence checks. The user manually saved exact Build bld-20260827-56284e4a-bc0c-4cb6-b873-a48d180693e2. New top-level same-repository parent bc-3e6bd3bd-f310-47cd-a9cb-358cf802f16d visibly used that Build, exposed nine native plus all 14 Kaola Task types, and exact implementer child bc-7d00ddad-23f3-5e69-8f9a-1c326b051a49 returned PROBE_OK_CURSOR_CLOUD_FINAL_SAVED_REPO_IMPLEMENTER with no substitute or per-call model override. Child model and profile-source carriers remained unobservable.

zcode_instructions.claim: User-global and workspace-root AGENTS.md files are supported directly.

devin_f1.claim: F1: `devin doctor --json` reported loaded profiles from user `~/.config/devin/agents/` and project `.devin/agents/`; `.claude/agents/` files were not counted.

devin_f2.claim: F2: A fresh `devin -p` session listed probe profiles from `.devin/agents/` plus built-ins `subagent_explore` and `subagent_general`; project `.claude/agents/*.md` did not appear. Parent reported `MODEL: Adaptive` and export showed `agent.model_name = Adaptive` with `generation_model = kimi-k2-7`.

devin_f3.claim: F3: Exact named foreground dispatch succeeded for probe profiles and `subagent_general` with no repository mutation; every parent step resolved to `generation_model = kimi-k2-7`.

devin_f4.claim: F4: Unpinned custom child profiles showed `You are powered by Subagent Default.`; `model: adaptive` showed `You are powered by Adaptive.`; `model: inherit` passed through as a literal model name (do not emit); `subagent_general` inherited the parent.

devin_f5.claim: F5: Subagent tray showed router labels (`Adaptive`, `Subagent Default`) rather than resolved model names.

devin_f6.claim: F6: A `subagent_general` child reported `PROFILES: NONE`, confirming `run_subagent` is unavailable inside a child and the default nesting depth is one.

devin_f7.claim: F7: A write-capable profile running in the background with no prior write grant was denied, leaving the target file uncreated; background agents automatically deny tools requiring approval.

devin_f8.claim: F8: Hook discovery loaded providers including `devin`, `agents_standard`, `cursor`, `windsurf`, `claude`, `opencode`, `zed`, `copilot` and loaded the Kaola Claude `SessionStart` hook from `~/.claude/settings.json` into Devin sessions (cross-host leak #1057).

devin_f9.claim: F9: The `SessionStart` hook fired with stdin containing `hook_event_name=SessionStart` and `source=startup`; its `additionalContext` reached the model verbatim.

devin_f10.claim: F10: A `PostCompaction` hook fired after `/compact` but its `additionalContext` did not reach the model, consistent with docs limiting `additionalContext` to `UserPromptSubmit`, `SessionStart`, and `PostToolUse`.

devin_f11.claim: F11: After `/compact` the model context dropped `SessionStart` context, AGENTS.md blocks, and imported `.cursor`/`.claude`/`.windsurf` rules; `KW-COMPACT-RECOVERY-START` went from present to absent.

devin_f12.claim: F12: A `UserPromptSubmit` hook after compaction injected `additionalContext` that was quoted by the model, making it the only deterministic post-compaction context carrier measured.

devin_f13.claim: F13: A profile created after session start failed with `Subagent failed to start`, byte-identical to an unknown name; the catalog is fixed at session start.

devin_f14.claim: F14: `devin doctor` is present in this build and does not validate `model` values; it accepted both `adaptive` and `inherit`.

subagent_default.summary: every installed Kaola profile pins `model: sonnet`; effort is not pinned and follows the runtime default; omit the per-call model unless the item needs a stronger child

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find named profiles in project `.claude/agents/`, user `~/.claude/agents/`, plugin `agents/`, managed settings, or the current session's `--agents`; managed/session/project/user/plugin precedence remains Claude-owned, and the Kaola installer uses the user directory by default.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Dispatch with `Agent` and `subagent_type: "<role>"`; installed Kaola profiles pin `model: sonnet`, so omit the per-call model unless the item needs a stronger child.
delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: The named profile's native `tools` allowlist carries the role tool boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native alternatives include the full `general-purpose` agent, read-only `Explore` and `Plan`, catch-all `claude`, background or isolated children, and optional agent teams; use only the route whose real capability fits the current item.
delegation_guidance.availability: Inspect the current Agent/Task type catalog and effective precedence. Claude currently permits recursive subagents to its native depth limit, which can be configured by the host; do not infer total child unavailability from one missing custom name.

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find custom profiles in project `.cursor/agents/` or user `~/.cursor/agents/`; a file on disk is not discovery proof, so inspect the live catalog. CLI, App local, and App Cloud are separate hosts. Materialize the selected project explicitly. Cloud requires installation in its environment setup, a tested and user-saved Build, then a new top-level Agent in the same repository; local install never deploys Cloud.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Inspect the current `Task` schema and send only fields it exposes. If the exact Kaola role is present and its materialized profile receipt is valid, call `Task` with the live flat `subagent_type: "<role>"` field and MUST omit the per-call `model`; an exact-binding requirement is a post-resolution assertion, never authorization to populate that field. Absence of medium/high from the generic Task model enum is not a named-profile capability gap. Verify the exact binding from `providerOptions.cursor.modelName` provider evidence when the host exposes it; a TUI child transcript alone is insufficient. Internal `subagentType.custom.name` is provider encoding, not controller call shape, and must not be sent. In a built-in-only enum, omit-model is the parent, not a profile pin.
delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: The named profile's native `readonly` flag carries its write boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Inspect the live Task catalog. Measured hosts exposed writable `generalPurpose` and host-specific built-ins; some hosts document scoped `Explore`, `Bash`, or `Browser`. Use only a route this host reports, under its real identity and capability.
delegation_guidance.fallback_search: If the exact name is absent, first distinguish an uninstalled or unsaved host carrier from a capability gap. Then inspect real alternatives for this item; a miss that the item's brief cannot absorb inlines only that item and records the specific `capability_gap`.
delegation_guidance.availability: The live Task catalog is authoritative. CLI build 2026.08.25-3e8eec8 proved project `implementer` dispatch and resolved `cursor-grok-4.6-medium`; App 3.17.21 and the saved Cloud Build each proved all 14 names plus exact `implementer` (the catalog then held 14 roles; 7 remain after #1062), but did not expose the child model carrier. CLI profile reload was observed after reopening the process; same-process hot load remains unknown.

compact_protocol.reload: Cursor includes alwaysApply Rules in every model context. V2 therefore completely reloads Workflow Next or Finalization after compact on CLI, App local, and Cloud even though Cloud lacks sessionStart and preCompact cannot inject context.

compact_protocol.stop: No stop prompt-lifecycle hook is installed.
compact_protocol.fast: Fast is prohibited for named Kaola dispatch and cannot override the profile's pinned model and effort.
compact_protocol.Explore: Built-in Explore is a truthful read-only route only when the live Cursor catalog exposes it; it cannot impersonate a missing Kaola role.

delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native routes are full `general-purpose` and read-only `Explore`, reached through automatic selection or `@`; foreground/background choice remains runtime-owned.
delegation_guidance.availability: Children follow the main Agent's model. Subagents cannot spawn children, but the root runtime's other native routes remain available.
